services.name: Bathroom cleaning

services.name: Kitchen cleaning

services.name: AC service

services.description: Not cooling, leaking water or making noise? A technician diagnoses and fixes it. Parts and gas extra.

services.name: Well chlorination

services.name: Garden maintenance
